title: Portuguese Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Portugal, featuring cannellini beans and a variety of spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the canned tomatoes, stew, and cannellini beans. Stir to combine.
Add the sliced fluffy portuguese bread and stir to coat with the stew mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bring the stew to a simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Serve with additional sliced fluffy portuguese bread on the side, if desired.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
